summary: Indian shares posted their biggest one-day rally in about seven months, with 39 of the 50 Nifty stocks higher and all but two sectors in the green.

detail.leaders: Bajaj Finance and Shriram Finance; IndiGo and Maruti on cheaper crude
detail.laggards: ONGC and the energy index on lower crude; Apollo Hospitals after results

up.summary: NBFCs led the rally, with oil consumers close behind
up.why: Four sessions of foreign buying lifted financials, and crude's slump to a two-month low helped oil consumers.
